name: Traveler (Electro)
notes: KQM has no Electro Traveler guide; the card rests on Game8 (Support Builds) and genshin-builds.com (Energy Support build, checked 2026-10-30). Both build an energy battery: an ER or ATK% Sands (ER only in genshin-builds), an Electro DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet. They differ on the set (Game8: 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate; genshin-builds lists Noblesse Oblige first, Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City and Instructor, and Emblem third), on the first weapon (Game8: Skyward Blade; genshin-builds: Favonius Sword), and on talent order (Game8: Burst > Skill; genshin-builds: Skill > Burst > Normal Attack). The card uses Game8's order and sets and lists both sources' weapons. The Burst's Falling Thunder (Skill DMG 114.4% to 205.9%, elemental curve) is the damage line, though the role is energy for the team; the Skill's amulets give energy and +20% ER. No source gives numeric goals, so none is set (the app fills them from the role). Partners are the elements that gain from the energy.
